tool_calls.reason: Find authoritative EU sources that discuss the Digital Markets Act
tool_calls.query: Digital Markets Act EU official legislation
tool_calls.content:
Here are the **official EU legal texts** for the **Digital Markets Act (DMA)**:

- **Main law (Digital Markets Act):** **Regulation (EU) 2022/1925** — *“on contestable and fair markets in the digital sector (Digital Markets Act)”* (adopted **14 September 2022**). ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32022R1925&utm_source=openai))  
  - Official consolidated/act text on EUR-Lex: `CELEX:32022R1925` ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32022R1925&utm_source=openai))

- **Commission “DMA legislation” landing page (EU official):** overview page pointing to the main legislative texts (and links to implementation materials). ([digital-markets-act.ec.europa.eu](https://digital-markets-act.ec.europa.eu/about-dma/legislation_en?utm_source=openai))

**Publication / entry into force (for timeline context):**
- The **Official Journal publication date** is **12 October 2022 (OJ L 265)** (as reflected in official EUR-Lex “history”/timeline views and summaries). ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/HIS/?uri=CELEX%3A32022R1925&utm_source=openai))  
- The **DMA entered into force** on **1 November 2022** (20 days after publication, per EU timeline summaries). ([europarl.europa.eu](https://www.europarl.europa.eu/thinktank/en/document/EPRS_BRI%282021%29690589?utm_source=openai))

If you tell me whether you want the **full text link**, the **Official Journal PDF**, or the **latest consolidated version**, I can point you to the exact EUR-Lex view for that.
